g.title: J_EPS_GNSS
g.text: EPS J21 (bottom side, +X edge, +Y side, zone Z3): SW7 3V3_GNSS (GNSS_EN PE5)

g.title: W9B
g.text: M22759/33-28, twisted pair; 0.10 A peak receiver, 0.232 A at the SW7 trip

g.title: J_OBC_GNSS
g.text: OBC J5: PG7 via U30, PG8 via U31, PC6 via U32

g.title: W9A
g.text: M22759/33-28; pairs (1, 2), (3, 6), (4, 5); the receiver-side contacts must take 28 AWG (SkyFox interface document at the EM purchase)

g.title: J_GNSS
g.text: receiver side; 3.3 V CMOS UART, 9600 baud NMEA
